caption: Read a local native export ZIP before import.
eval: (async()=>{ window.zohoQaModal?.close(); window.zohoQaModal=null; app.plugins.plugins['zoho-znote-import'].pro.signOut(); const p = app.plugins.plugins['zoho-znote-import']; const f = app.vault.getFileByPath('Zoho Znote Import/Demo export.zip'); const bytes = new Uint8Array(await app.vault.readBinary(f)); if (!app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('Zoho sample')) await p.importBytes(bytes,'Zoho sample'); window.zohoQaModal=p.openImport(); const selected=new File([bytes],'Demo export.zip'); const input=window.zohoQaModal.contentEl.querySelector('input[type=file]'); const transfer=new DataTransfer(); transfer.items.add(selected); input.files=transfer.files; await window.zohoQaModal.selectFile(selected); return 'ok'; })()

caption: A local Pro profile maps notebook and field names.
eval: (async()=>{window.zohoQaModal?.close(); window.zohoQaModal=null; const p = app.plugins.plugins['zoho-znote-import']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('zoho-znote-import-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await p.saveProfile({name:'Travel',notebookFolders:{'Travel journal':'Trips'},fields:{color:'card_color'}}); window.zohoQaModal=p.openImport(); window.zohoQaModal.profileName='Travel'; window.zohoQaModal.notebookJson=JSON.stringify({'Travel journal':'Trips'}); window.zohoQaModal.fieldsJson=JSON.stringify({color:'card_color'}); window.zohoQaModal.useProfile=true; window.zohoQaModal.renderMapping(document.querySelector('.zoho-import-dialog textarea').closest('.setting-item').parentElement); const d=document.querySelector('.zoho-import-dialog select');d.value='Travel';return 'ok';})()
